payload.body: You tend to hide how much you like something until the choice has almost passed. The purchase stays in the cart, the attraction becomes a joke, or the preference gets described as impractical before anyone else can judge it. Underneath is often an old lesson that wanting made you shallow, selfish, expensive, or difficult to please. Name the preference before explaining why having it is a bad idea.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct Venus can make desire, taste, and old shame difficult to separate from one another.
